items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: He was our band leader. And I played saxophone and clarinet.

ctx.x: No, on the floor. On the floor? Yeah, on the floor. Yeah, it was fine. And after that, my cousin and my brother used to play mandolin and guitar, you know? And by listening to them, I just liked myself, you know, just by listening. So I learned how to play mandolin and my first song that I played was Home Sweet Home and I was hitting a note every five minutes, you know, and my sister called me to go get a bucket of water from the well. So I said, we used to call it Chook, the nickname, you know? And I said, yeah,…
